$comment: Code that exists only in the preview-diagnostics build (DG1, docs/architecture/notes/diagnostics-screen.md §3.3). `bundle:check` fails when a source-map module path contains a pattern or a marker occurs in any file under `_expo/static/js/<platform>/` of the production export (bundles and maps, android and ios); `bundle:check:diagnostics` exports with EXPO_PUBLIC_CODELEX_DIAGNOSTICS=1 and requires a diagnostics source, a golden-runner source and every marker (the report file name included) (positive control, so the absence check cannot pass by being blind).
